title: Languages Google publisher products support - Google Ad Manager Help

facts.fact: Google publisher products support publishers in several languages, and sites can select their primary language during sign-up.
facts.quote: You can select your site's primary language during the sign-up process.

facts.fact: Placing Google ad code on pages with content primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted under the Google Publisher Policies.
facts.quote: Placing Google ad code on pages with content primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted by the Google Publisher Policies.

facts.fact: The AdSense product interface and help center are not currently available in Estonian and Slovenian.
facts.quote: [1] The AdSense product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.

facts.fact: The Ad Manager product interface and help center are not currently available in Arabic.
facts.quote: [2] The Ad Manager product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.

facts.fact: The AdMob product interface is not currently available in Urdu.
facts.quote: [3] The AdMob product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.
